name: Vitamin B12
short_note: May help cognitive health if deficient. Consult physician before use.
dosage_info: Typical OTC dose: 500-1000 mcg daily. Consult doctor for specific needs.

name: Omega-3 Fatty Acids (Fish Oil)
short_note: Supports brain health. Consult doctor if on blood thinners.
dosage_info: Typical OTC dose: 1000 mg daily. Consult doctor.

name: Vitamin D3
short_note: Essential for brain function. Check levels with a doctor first.
dosage_info: Typical OTC dose: 1000-2000 IU daily. Consult doctor.

name: Multivitamin (Senior Formula)
short_note: General nutritional support. Ensure it is iron-free if recommended by doctor.
dosage_info: One tablet daily with food. Consult doctor.
